excerpt.zh: 一个通往这颗小行星内部的对接舱坐落在其表面的一个小坑里。舱口似乎被密封过，但之后被微陨石撞开了。
excerpt.en: A small docking hatch leading to the interior of this asteroid is visible at the rim of a small crater on its surface. The hatch was likely concealed once, but it has since been exposed by micrometeorite impacts.

texts.zh: 大约在一千年前，有一群外星海盗断断续续地将这颗小行星当做基地。我们进入该基地后，找到了当时被遗弃宝箱。其中主要是各种偷来的珠宝和文物，其中一些看起来还相当有价值。
texts.en: This asteroid appears to have been used intermittently as a base by a band of alien pirates roughly one thousand years ago. By entering the base, we managed to recover their abandoned treasure hoard. It consisted largely of stolen trinkets and artifacts, but some of it still appears to be of value.

label.zh: 这些不义之财应该为我们所用。
label.en: These ill-gotten gains shall serve us well.

texts.zh: [From.GetName]小行星内部的大部分都被挖空，用于建造疑似是船坞的工程，然而该工程早已被遗弃，数个世纪以来，一直暴露在宇宙的真空之中。就算里面曾有一些有价值的东西遗留，也早已被之前的探索者掠夺一空。船坞的设计非常独特，有很多值得借鉴学习之处。
texts.en: A large portion of asteroid [From.GetName] has been hollowed out to allow for the construction of some kind of shipyard. It has been abandoned and exposed to the vacuum of space for centuries - if anything useful remained, it has already been looted by previous explorers. The design of the shipyard itself is unique, however, and much could potentially be learned by its study.

label.zh: 我们应该研究一下它的设计。

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这颗小行星的名称。
note.en: In the game, this asteroid's name appears here.

summary.text:
# 对接舱 / Docking Hatch

- 分类 Category：深空异闻 Exploration · 审阅 Reviewed：2026-10-13（已审阅 reviewed）
- 来源 Sources：common/anomalies/00_anomaly_categories.txt:114; events/anomaly_events_1.txt:48 (anomaly.5); events/anomaly_events_1.txt:177 (anomaly.25)

## 如何开始 How it starts

小行星可能生成（3级，权重3）。

Can spawn on an asteroid (level 3, weight 3).

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

anomaly.5“海盗宝藏”（每月能量加成，触发 pop_lcluster_event；拥有上古遗物 DLC 时再给小型遗物奖励）与 anomaly.25“废弃船厂”（工程矿藏 d_engineering_3 + derelict_shipyard 修正；若星球有战略资源则权重为0）。

anomaly.5 "Pirate Treasure" (monthly energy, pop_lcluster_event, plus a small artifact reward with Ancient Relics) and anomaly.25 "Derelict Shipyard" (d_engineering_3 deposit plus the derelict_shipyard modifier; weight 0 if the planet has a strategic resource).

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

两个结果互斥，各50%；有战略资源时只会得到 anomaly.5。

The results are exclusive, 50% each; with a strategic resource only anomaly.5.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

无文明差异。

No empire differences.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

已核对异常定义与全部结果事件；编译树正确，无需改动。

Checked the anomaly definition and every outcome event; the compiled tree is correct, no change needed.
